newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli family disappears on way to son's wedding.
newsitem.headline: Israeli family disappears on way to son's wedding.

text.p: Israeli and Palestinian forces conducted wide searches on Friday in the Jordan Valley area of the West Bank for an Israeli family that went missing with their son on the way to his wedding, security sources.
"There is no estimation. They are checking if it was a car accident or if there was terrorist activity," an Israeli security source told Reuters when asked what police thought had happened.

Eli and Claudine Pel left their Jerusalem home in the afternoon on Thursday with their bridegroom son Uri and two of his friends for the wedding near the northern Israeli town of Tiberias. They never arrived.
They had intended to travel via the West Bank's Jordan Valley, a quicker route than going through Israel to Tiberias.

Israeli forces searched villages along the route overnight and set up roadblocks. Palestinian forces searched areas under their jurisdiction. A helicopter and two Israeli air force planes joined in the search.

"We're all following this anxiously and doing everything so that we'll be able to know what happened, how it happened," Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy told Israel Radio, emphasising he hoped the family was found safe.
The Israeli security source noted that more than a year ago a man went missing in the Jordan Valley area and it was days before he was found dead in his car which had gone off the road into a wadi.
In April, Israeli troops found the body of a soldier who had disappeared in September in a West Bank village. He had been kidnapped and killed by the militant Moslem group Hamas.
